==Description==
'''Coral Deep''' is an underwater [[Maps|map]] that can be played on in survival modes.

It has the [[Scuba Gear]] modifier, which applies scuba helmets to enemies and makes them leave bubbles on death.

==Design & Path==
'''Coral Deep''' takes place inside an underwater cave containing colorful coral reefs. The walls are made out of stone while the ground is full of sand. In this cave, a few notable structures can be found. Most noticeably, there is a giant shipwreck in the center of the map. At both the entrance and exit, there are small white temples. There is also a small grey broken statue and a broken bridge.

The path starts and ends at a portal in a temple. It contains multiple long straights and a few turns.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The back part of the map has ideal placement and contains cliff spots, however, despite its better coverage, majority of towers will be unable to even reach anywhere close to the entrance.
**This means that, while the beginning part of the map has far worse range coverage, it does allow for far faster match times.
*While this map does have cliff spots, they are quite limited, meaning only a few cliff towers can be placed.
**The only cliff spots in this map are, however, in a great spot, allowing cliff towers to cover majority of the path.
